title: Carve 0.2 URL policy and profiles
description: The tables of the URL filter and of the four profiles (C2-H-159 to C2-H-164). The default deny list of schemes is the default of `urlPolicy` in options.json. Every list is sorted by its identifier: `probe_removes`, `dropped_attributes`, `url_list_attributes` and `profiles` by `name`, `style_patterns` by `text`.

probe_removes.description: The characters removed from a value before its scheme is read: every code point from `from` to `to`, both included.

dropped_attributes.description: Attribute names the renderer never writes, compared without ASCII case. name: the whole name. prefix: every name that starts with it.

url_list_attributes.description: Attributes whose value is a list of URLs, tested token by token. The separators split the value into tokens; ascii_whitespace is tab, line feed, form feed, carriage return and space.

style_patterns.description: A `style` value that holds one of these texts, after its CSS escapes are decoded, its whitespace removed and its ASCII letters lowered, is written empty.

profiles.description: The four values of `profile`. An absent allow list allows every type of its axis; an absent deny list denies none; an absent limit is no limit.

link_rel.description: The tokens of the `rel` attribute written on every link.

max_nesting.description: The deepest level a node may stand at below the document, every block and inline level counted.

max_length.description: The longest input accepted, in UTF-8 bytes.

clauses.description: The clause ids of the six 0.2 documents that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.
